2607.15557.title: SkillCorpus: Consolidating and Evaluating the Open Skill Ecosystem for Real-World LLM Agents
2607.15557.paper_summary: Agent skills, SKILL.md files that package reusable procedural knowledge for an LLM agent, are a popular mechanism for extending agent capabilities. Public repositories now host them in large and growing numbers, yet these artifacts are fragmented, redundant, and uneven in quality, and their value in practice is unclear. A core question remains open, namely how to consolidate this open-source SKILL.md ecosystem into a single usable corpus, and what bounds its benefit on real-world agent tasks. We present SkillCorpus, a framework that aggregates, curates, matches, and evaluates the open skill ecosystem at scale. It filters ~821,000 crawled skills through a multi-stage pipeline into 96,401 skills organised by a 16-class taxonomy and three quality facets (utility, robustness, safety), and pairs them with a fine-tuned retrieval-and-selection stack that matches task-relevant skills. We evaluate end-to-end across three benchmarks (SkillsBench, GDPVal, QwenClawBench), two harnesses, and two open backbones with a frontier robustness check. Integrating SkillCorpus yields consistent gains across all three benchmarks, largest on SkillsBench (+7.5 pp). An operational analysis traces the gains to a coverage boundary and a harness boundary. SkillCorpus is, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end account of when a curated, retrieval-served community corpus improves real agent tasks, and where it does not. The dataset, models, and code will be released upon acceptance.
2607.15557.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能，SKILL.md 文件包裝了可重用的程序知識，用於 LLM 代理，是擴展代理能力的一種流行機制。公共存儲庫現在以大量且不斷增長的數量來承載它們，但這些工件是分散的、冗餘的，且質量不均，其在實踐中的價值尚不清楚。一個核心問題仍然懸而未決，即如何將這個開源的 SKILL.md 生態系統整合成一個可用的語料庫，以及它在現實世界代理任務中的效益邊界。我們提出了 SkillCorpus，一個在規模上聚合、策劃、匹配和評估開放技能生態系統的框架。它通過多階段流程過濾約 821,000 個爬取的技能，最終整理出 96,401 個技能，這些技能按照 16 類分類法和三個質量面向（實用性、穩健性、安全性）進行組織，並與一個經過微調的檢索和選擇堆疊配對，以匹配任務相關的技能。我們在三個基準（SkillsBench、GDPVal、QwenClawBench）、兩個工具和兩個開放骨幹上進行了端到端的評估，並進行了前沿穩健性檢查。整合 SkillCorpus 在所有三個基準上都帶來了一致的增益，其中在 SkillsBench 上的增益最大（+7.5 pp）。運營分析將增益追溯到覆蓋邊界和工具邊界。據我們所知，SkillCorpus 是首個端到端的報告，說明了何時策劃的、檢索服務的社區語料庫能改善真實代理任務，以及何時無法改善。數據集、模型和代碼將在接受後發布。
